title: Angry Chick and Ghost Bride
description: A surreal circular painting shows an angry yellow chick wearing a blue jacket standing on a branch, facing a translucent ghost bride with a flower crown. They are positioned under a gnarled tree with a robot and a bat, against a night landscape with a yellow moon, green hills, and floating hearts.
prompt: A surreal circular painting with red border and decorative purple frame, featuring an angry yellow chick in a blue jacket standing on a tree branch facing a translucent purple ghost bride with flower crown. A small white robot sits in the gnarled tree holding a red heart on a string, a bat flies near a glowing yellow moon in a swirling purple night sky. Green rolling hills with houses and ponds containing ghost frogs and hearts fill the background, whimsical folk art style with vibrant colors and magical details.
